title: Rating Bonus Schedule for Superhost Travel Credits — Host Accounts
content:
# Superhost Perk Schedule — Rating Bonus on a Travel Credit (Host Accounts)

**Rule.** A Roamhaven travel credit of a Host Accounts Superhost also carries a rating bonus of **USD 20.00** when the average ratings recorded at the account's Superhost assessments recorded as met and dated within the 12 months before the credit average at least **4.9** stars, a rating bonus of **USD 10.00** when they average at least **4.85** but less than 4.9 stars, and no rating bonus otherwise. The rating bonus is added to the base amount and the stays bonus before that sum is rounded.

The 12 months hold the assessments dated fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the date of the credit; only assessments recorded as met are averaged.

## Boundary table

| Average of the recorded ratings at met assessments in the 12 months | Rating bonus |
|---|---|
| 4.90 or more | USD 20.00 |
| 4.85 up to but not including 4.90 | USD 10.00 |
| Below 4.85 | None |

## Worked case (hypothetical)

Three met assessments in the 12 months recorded average ratings of 4.88, 4.91 and 4.86 stars. Their average is 4.8833: at least 4.85 but below 4.9, so the rating bonus is USD 10.00. A fourth met assessment at 4.97 would lift the average to 4.905, and the bonus to USD 20.00.
